captions.linkedin:
"Can't I just paste my resume into a chatbot?" You can, and it'll write something fluent. What it can't do is tell which facts are true about you, so skills and numbers drift in.

QuickFit CV treats your profile as the source of truth:

• a chatbot doesn't know which facts are actually yours
• QuickFit CV checks every skill, date and number against your profile after the AI writes
• not in your profile? Not on your resume

One rule throughout: QuickFit CV never adds a skill, employer, date or number that isn't yours.

Free to try: https://quickfitcv.com

#jobsearch #resume #careers #ats
